## Load Data

```{r}
nhanes <- read_csv("examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv", 
                    show_col_types = FALSE)
nhanes |> head()
```

### Descriptive BMI summary by IncomeGroup and Gender

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
bmi_summary_df <- nhanes |> 

filter(IncomeGroup != "NA",
               BMI != "NA") |>
group_by(IncomeGroup, Gender) |>
summarize(n = n(),
    mean_BMI = mean(BMI),
            sd_BMI = sd(BMI),
        median_BMI = median(BMI),
           max_BMI = max(BMI),
           min_BMI = min(BMI)

            )
bmi_summary_df
```

### Refactor the R Summary into One Small Reusable Function
```{r}
bmi_summary <- function(df) {

     summarized_bmi <- df |> 
            filter(IncomeGroup != "NA", BMI != "NA") |>
            group_by(IncomeGroup, Gender) |>
            summarize(mean_BMI = mean(BMI),
                        sd_BMI = sd(BMI),
                    median_BMI = median(BMI),
                    max_BMI = max(BMI),
                    min_BMI = min(BMI))
      summarized_bmi
}
```

#### Testing out the Customized `bmi_summary` Function
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
bmi_summary(nhanes)
```

### Complete a parity table comparing row counts, filtered row counts, grouping labels, and rounded summary values
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
parity_table <- function(df) {
     unfilter <- df |> 
     group_by(IncomeGroup, Gender) |>
     summarize(unfiltered_count = n())

      summary_filtered_bmi  <- df |>
                                filter(IncomeGroup != "NA", BMI != "NA") |>
                                group_by(IncomeGroup, Gender) |>
                                summarize(filtered_count = n(),
                                                mean_BMI = round(mean(BMI),2),
                                                  sd_BMI = round(sd(BMI),2),
                                              median_BMI = round(median(BMI),2),
                                                 max_BMI = round(max(BMI),2),
                                                 min_BMI = round(min(BMI),2),
                                                  .groups = "drop")
      joined_df <- merge(unfilter, summary_filtered_bmi, by = c("IncomeGroup", "Gender")) 
      joined_df
}

```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
parity_table(nhanes)
```
